nodes.name: backend-routes.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive inventory of all existing Waggle OS sidecar REST endpoints (organized into 14 domain groups 03a–03g) and a cross-reference against the PRD §16 target endpoints, with summary counts identifying gaps and coverage for the UX refactor.

nodes.name: frontend.md
nodes.summary: Inventory of the apps/web/src frontend component tree cataloging 26+ app shells, 14 overlays, shell/runtime wiring (window manager, dock, keyboard shortcuts), the LocalAdapter singleton data layer, domain hooks, and design-system primitives as a baseline for the UX refactor.

nodes.name: substrate-types.md
nodes.summary: Audits the TypeScript type and database schema surface — WorkspaceConfig, workspace-state builder outputs, mind schema tables, install-audit, and frontend type delta vs PRD §15.2–§15.6 — identifying gaps and migration requirements for the UX refactor.
